name: Phalanx leader
description: A phalanx captain who reports to the Dekatia that the Weeping Woman is now leading three children and could not bring himself to strike them down.

timeline.summary: The phalanx leader reports to Perisophia and the council that the Weeping Woman is no longer alone and leads three masked children.
timeline.quote: We have again seen the Weeping Woman. And... she is no longer alone.

timeline.summary: The captain admits he could not strike down the children, and Perisophia comforts him, saying tenderness stayed his hand.
timeline.quote: Tenderness, not weakness, stayed your hand.

timeline.summary: At the salt marsh the priests chant while the young widower pours the lekythos into the water, drawing the Weeping Woman and children from the mist.
timeline.quote: Then, out of the mists, she came.

timeline.summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.

relations.note: He reports to her as Speaker.
relations.quote: "Honored Speaker Perisophia, I pray you will forgive this intrusion."
